# Talks — Yogic Approach

> Recorded yoga talks and class series by Satchidananda, each with transcripts, notes and study tools (AI-assisted, human-reviewed).

Site: https://yogicapproach.com

## Exploring the Koshas — A Framework for Awareness | The Five Koshas, TTC-300 Uruguay

A synthesis of a four-session teacher-training on the five koshas by Satchidananda — Uruguay, June 2026. Bilingual (English / Spanish).

- [Exploring the Koshas — A Framework for Awareness | The Five Koshas, TTC-300 Uruguay](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/)
- [Five Koshas — Feedback / Comentarios](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/feedback/participant/)
- [Glossary of Terms | The Five Koshas — TTC-300, Uruguay](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/glossary/): Glossary of yoga and Sanskrit terms, with definitions drawn from the four Koshas sessions by Satchidananda.
- [The Five Koshas · Knowledge Graph](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/graph/): Interactive force-directed concept map of the five koshas — built by text analysis of a four-session TTC-300 series by Satchidananda.
- [The Five Koshas · A Four-Session Series](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/index-hub-legacy.html): Interactive bilingual student notes on the five koshas — a four-session TTC-300 series by Satchidananda.
- [The Five Koshas — Transcripts | TTC-300, Uruguay](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/read/)
- [The Five Koshas | The Five Koshas — TTC-300, Uruguay](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/s1/): Satchidananda — 300-Hour Teacher Training, Uruguay — June 10, 2026 — The Five Koshas
- [Connection | The Five Koshas — TTC-300, Uruguay](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/s2/): Satchidananda — 300-Hour Teacher Training, Uruguay — June 16, 2026 — The Five Koshas
- [Sound & Mantra | The Five Koshas — TTC-300, Uruguay](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/s3/): Satchidananda — 300-Hour Teacher Training, Uruguay — June 18, 2026 — The Five Koshas
- [Sound, Mantra & Visualization | The Five Koshas — TTC-300, Uruguay](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/s4/): Satchidananda — 300-Hour Teacher Training, Uruguay — June 23, 2026 — The Five Koshas
- [Corpus — the teacher’s own words (Koshas · TTC-300)](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/search/): Search a corpus of the teacher's own recorded transcripts. Every passage carries a timestamp you can cite and a click-to-audio link.
- [Note + citations demo — Koshas corpus](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/search/note-demo.html): A sample student note whose inline citations resolve live to the teacher's own recorded words.
- [The Five Koshas · Student Notes · Session 1](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/sessions/session-1/): Interactive bilingual student notes on the five koshas — grounded in the Session-1 TTC-300 talk by Satchidananda.
- [The Five Koshas · Student Notes · Session 2](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/sessions/session-2/): Interactive multilingual student notes on the five koshas — grounded in the Session-2 TTC-300 talk by Satchidananda (Connection: wakefulness, scale & the gunas).
- [Sound & Mantra · Student Notes · Session 3](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/sessions/session-3/): Interactive trilingual student notes on sound & mantra and the five koshas — grounded in the Session-3 TTC-300 talk by Satchidananda.
- [Sound, Mantra & Visualization · Student Notes · Session 4](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/sessions/session-4/): Interactive trilingual student notes on sound, mantra and visualization — grounded in the final Session-4 TTC-300 talk by Satchidananda.
- [Transcript Portal · The Five Koshas (TTC-300, Uruguay)](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/transcript/): Searchable bilingual (EN/ES) transcript portal for the four-session Koshas teaching — search across sessions, jump to the matching moment in the transcript.

## Yoga Sutras — Exploration and Application

One sutra at a time, taken from the page into practice: the verse, its commentaries, and a class built around experiencing it.

- [Yoga Sutras — Exploration and Application](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/yoga-sutras-exploration/)
- [Sutra 2:42 — Santosha | Yoga Sutras — Exploration and Application | 15 September 2026](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/yoga-sutras-exploration/ch02-v42-santosha/): From contentment, unsurpassed happiness is gained. Class by Satchidananda, Janardhana, Instituto Yoga Carrasco, Montevideo, 15 September 2026.
- [Sutra 2:43 — Tapas | Yoga Sutras — Exploration and Application | 27 October 2026](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/yoga-sutras-exploration/ch02-v43-tapas/): From tapas, through the destruction of impurity, comes perfection of the body and the senses. Class by Satchidananda, Janardhana, Instituto Yoga Carrasco, Montevideo, 27 October 2026.
- [Yoga Sutra II.43, tapas: quotes](https://yogicapproach.com/en/talks/yoga-sutras-exploration/ch02-v43-tapas/resources/quotes-collection.html)
